header.name: Quality Intervals
header.description: Screen to define quality intervals that are used for quality subject lists to generate quality checks/reports.

props.label: Process Offset Min
props.description: Time in minutes from start of process(or last qc if repeat) to begin QC check. For use with intraprocess intervals.

props.label: Process Offset Max
props.description: Time in minutes from start of process(or last qc if repeat) to begin QC check. For use with intraprocess intervals.

props.label: Quantity Min
props.description: The production quantity required to trigger qc check

props.label: Quantity Max
props.description: The production quantity required to trigger qc check

props.label: Repeat
props.description: The interval repeats (as per shiftoffset/ processoffset/ quantity). default=false

label.__transform: data.qualityIntervalType.id = 'IntraProcess-Minutes' ? 'Process Offset (max 59 minutes)' : data.qualityIntervalType.id = 'IntraProcess-Hours' ? 'Process Offset (max 23 hours)'

fields.description: Time in minutes/hours (depending on qualityIntervalType IntraProcess-Minutes or IntraProcess-Hours) from start of process(or last qc if repeat) to begin QC check. For use with intraprocess intervals.

fields.label: Quantity
fields.description: The production quantity required to trigger qc check

fields.label: Repeat
fields.description: The interval repeats (as per shiftoffset/ processoffset/ quantity). default=false

transforms.post:
result.qualityIntervalTypeId = "IntraProcess-Minutes" ? result.processOffset <= 0 or result.processOffset >= 60 ? $throw("Process offset must be at least 1 minute and at most 59 minutes") : result
: result.qualityIntervalTypeId = "IntraProcess-Hours" ? result.processOffset <= 0 or result.processOffset >= 24 ? $throw("Process offset must be at least 1 hour and at most 23 hours") : result
: result

label.__transform: data.qualityIntervalType.id = 'IntraProcess-Minutes' ? 'Process Offset (max 59 minutes)' : data.qualityIntervalType.id = 'IntraProcess-Hours' ? 'Process Offset (max 23 hours)'
